meta.title: Fix: SeleniumScrapingTool initializes Chrome WebDriver only when needed
meta.body_summary: Implement lazy initialization of Chrome WebDriver in SeleniumScrapingTool to avoid unnecessary browser launch and memory leaks.

core_change_summary.description: In crewai_tools/tools/selenium_scraping_tool/selenium_scraping_tool.py, moved WebDriver creation from __init__ to a new _create_driver_instance method called only when needed, and updated close method for cleanup. Added tests for lazy init behavior.
